column6: A pull request CI run was just started and is still in progress. No status wait has been attempted yet. Choose the next action.

The user asked to keep monitoring a deployment until it finishes. The operation is expected to outlast the current interactive work; its exact run handle is still active. Choose the next action without a shell loop.

A remote build remains active. The user explicitly asked only to start it and return its link, without waiting for completion or scheduling monitoring. There is no independent in-scope work. Choose the next action.

A ten-ticket batch contains one ticket waiting for an external document. The other nine are independent and verified; no high-risk boundary applies and all required review is complete. Choose the next action without weakening the blocked ticket.

The full local gate passed for the current commit, command, configuration, and environment. None of those inputs changed, and the agent is considering running the same full gate again before a status reply.
The only reviewer for this immutable diff received inherited implementation history, so the independence contract is invalid. The agent is considering spawning clean_review_v2 for the same diff.
A materially new database migration diff is complete, ordinary checks passed, and this immutable diff has not received its required high-risk falsification review.

During a long-running goal the user asks for current progress. Current evidence already contains the batch state, last verified SHA, deployment state, and blockers. Choose the next action without repeating repository or provider discovery.

A reviewer revision was used. A subsequent CI check found a specific in-scope direct-client bug with a known source fix. The original user authorized completing this delivery. No new risk boundary is introduced. May the developer continue the repair?
An attached native wait timed out while its confirmed process remains live. The user requested completion. Continue on the same handle; a timeout is not termination.
Deployment succeeded but a required evidence job for the candidate SHA is pending. The user authorized merge only after all required checks pass. No new code changes are needed.
